SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, s.store_address AS storeAddress, CAST(s.store_lat AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS storeLat, CAST(s.store_lng AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS storeLng, s.store_image_url AS storeImageUrl,
b.brand_id AS brandId, b.brand_name AS brandName, b.brand_image_url AS brandImageUrl,
be.benefit_id AS benefitId, be.benefit_type AS benefitType, be.benefit_content AS benefitContent, be.benefit_discount AS benefitDiscount, be.benefit_condition AS benefitCondition FROM store s JOIN brand b ON s.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN benefit be ON s.store_id = be.store_id WHERE s.store_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.brand_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR be.benefit_content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR be.benefit_condition ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY s.store_id DESC, be.benefit_id DESC
SELECT search_id AS searchId, keyword, search_date AS searchDate FROM search_history WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY search_date DESC LIMIT 10
